summary: Validated simplified inline category flow in admin course form end-to-end on preview URL. Backend regression for category creation/normalization/auth/rollback passed; UI verifies one category input with datalist suggestions, create/edit/cancel behaviors, and no standalone category manager section.
action_items: Optional tech-debt cleanup: resolve existing React hook dependency warnings from build output in AdminCourses/CourseDetail/Leaderboard.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminCourses.js remains a very large file (~1.1k lines); split by tab/dialog components for maintainability.
No dangling frontend/backend runtime references found for removed standalone category manager routes/components; only read-only GET /api/categories remains.
No API write path for categories outside admin course POST/PUT detected (auth path preserved).
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_* courses/categories through admin course create flow during API/UI tests; course records were cleaned up where tracked in pytest teardown, category rows are intentionally retained because category delete API is removed by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL and refreshed ADMIN_SESSION/USER_SESSION are valid. Targeted regression file for this change is test_inline_category_course_flow_iteration9.py. R2 upload is intentionally not verified (credentials unavailable); attachment URL preservation during category-only update was validated with fixture URLs.
rca of the issue: No functional regressions found in tested scope. Initial Playwright attempts failed due test-script assumptions (waiting for visible datalist and flaky modal cancel-click detachment), not application logic. Final run used hidden-safe datalist checks and stable modal close handling; flow passed.
